attributes.title: CSNO 77th Annual Conference
attributes.cme_provider: California School Nurses Organization (California BRN provider CEP #04269)
attributes.summary:
The California School Nurses Organization holds its 77th Annual Conference from February 11 to 14, 2027, in Riverside, California, with pre-event workshops on February 10 and 11. The theme is "Growing Together Through Leadership and Innovation," and the program is built for credentialed school nurses and other nurses working in K-12 settings.

CSNO is an approved continuing education provider of the California Board of Registered Nursing (CEP #04269); the number of contact hours for this conference had not been posted. Registration opened October 5, 2026, and the early bird deadline is January 7, 2027. CSNO lists four conference hotels in Riverside but no single venue, and fees were not shown on the public page when we checked.
